source.provider: Eaton Vance / MSIM product data service (www.eatonvance.com/im/json/imwebdata) + SEC EDGAR (Form 497K fees and inception, Form N-PORT-P holdings, net assets and monthly NAV returns) + Yahoo Finance public chart API (market price, history and dividends)

inception.source: official Eaton Vance / MSIM product data

expense.source: official Eaton Vance / MSIM product data (net and gross expense ratio; terValue is the net ratio)

nav.source: official Eaton Vance / MSIM product data (pricing)

marketPrice.source: official Eaton Vance / MSIM product data (market price)

premiumDiscount.source: computed from the issuer NAV and market price of the same date

bidAskSpread.source: official Eaton Vance / MSIM product data (median bid/ask spread)

aum.source: derived: shares outstanding x NAV (the issuer publishes no net assets figure)

yields.dividendYieldKind: indicated (latest distribution x payments per year / market price)
yields.secYieldKind: 30-day SEC yield as published by eatonvance.com, as of Sep 30 2026

returns.derivedFrom: official Eaton Vance / MSIM published returns; month-to-date and history-derived periods use the Yahoo Finance adjusted series
returns.quarterEndBasis: official Eaton Vance / MSIM quarter-end NAV returns (fund detail page)
returns.returnsBasis: official Eaton Vance / MSIM month-end NAV returns (fund detail page)

distributions.source: official Eaton Vance / MSIM distribution schedule
